mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_steps (task_id, stage, status, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_message) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{stage}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, stage, status, started_at, finished_at, error_code, error_message FROM task_steps WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY FIELD(stage, 'MATERIAL_CHECK', 'GENERATE', 'FINALIZE')
